Authentication/authorization-focused recon summary.

Auth model: jwt. Details: HS256 JWTs issued by app/auth/service.py, refresh tokens in Redis.

Auth/session/RBAC modules and middleware candidates: 8 total, showing top 8:
- app/auth/service.py (python) - Session and JWT issuance
- app/auth/rbac.py (python)
- app/web/middleware/csrf.js (javascript) - CSRF middleware

- app/auth/permissions.py (python) - Role → permission table
- app/common/guard.py (python) - Assorted guard helpers
- db/migrate/2024_add_roles.rb (ruby) - Adds role column
- app/common/jwt_tools.py (python)
